source='''def transform(grid):
    # Find the regular separator rows and columns, then repeat the unique
    # non-background tile across the full array of tiles.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Separator color is the one forming periodic full-width / full-height lines.
    sep_rows = [r for r in row_lines if r not in (0, h-1)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in col_lines if c not in (0, w-1)]
    # Retain only lines that are non-background dividers, choosing the most
    # frequent interior line color when several uniform lines are present.
    row_colors = [grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows]
    col_colors = [grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols]
    def most_common(vals):
        return max(set(vals), key=vals.count) if vals else None
    rc, cc = most_common(row_colors), most_common(col_colors)
    sep_rows = [r for r in sep_rows if grid[r][0] == rc]
    sep_cols = [c for c in sep_cols if grid[0][c] == cc]
    rbounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    tiles = []
    for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = rbounds[ri]+1, rbounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cbounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = cbounds[ci]+1, cbounds[ci+1]
            tiles.append([row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]])
    # Background is the most common color among non-divider cells.
    divider = set(sep_rows)
    divc = set(sep_cols)
    vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in divider for c in range(w) if c not in divc]
    background = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    exemplar = next((t for t in tiles if any(x != background for row in t for x in row)), tiles[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    k=0
    for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = rbounds[ri]+1, rbounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cbounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = cbounds[ci]+1, cbounds[ci+1]
            for i in range(r1-r0):
                out[r0+i][c0:c1] = exemplar[i][:]
    return out
'''
